coverage_deep.explantion: Both responses are surface‑level, lack mechanistic explanations, and provide no concrete examples. Their shortcomings are comparable across the hierarchy of failures, making any difference trivial. Hence, they tie in deep coverage.

consistency_internal.explantion: Both Response a and Response b exhibit the same categories of internal consistency failures: each contains blurred viewpoint/conflation, false consensus, and attribution failures.
